# Apps that are also MCP servers (working name)

> One typed object — `defineApp({ entities, actions, pages, fragments, agents, … })` from `@mcpw/server` — becomes a JSON manifest (for hosts that draw the app natively) and a plain, conformant MCP server with tools, annotations and MCP Apps views (for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client). No MCP extension required.

## Start here

- [AI guide](ai-guide.md): the complete single-file reference for coding agents — the whole `defineApp` shape, the rules, the common mistakes, a full example. Read this one file to build an app.

## More

- [Specification](spec.md): the manifest, the generated MCP server, enforcement, conformance (normative, short)
- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): a first app, run in the MCP Inspector and ChatGPT, tested
- [CRM example](examples/crm.md): the reference app; code in `examples/mcp-workspaces/crm/src/app.ts`
- JSON Schema of the manifest: `packages/app-spec/schema/app-manifest.schema.json`
